summary: Combines attributes from multiple POP inputs by name or pattern and sends selected attributes to the output, with optional renaming, duplicate-name handling, and length-mismatch notifications.

key_params.name: attrclass
key_params.note: Point, vertex, or primitive attributes to combine

key_params.name: lengthmismatchnotif
key_params.note: Notification behavior for input length mismatch

key_params.name: duplicateattrs
key_params.note: How duplicate attribute names are resolved

key_params.name: input
key_params.note: Input blocks that select sources and attributes

key_params.name: input0attrs
key_params.note: Attribute scope for an input block

key_concepts: Combines attributes from multiple POP inputs by selecting source POPs and attribute patterns per sequential input block.
The first input contributes its attributes to the output while later inputs contribute the selected point, vertex, or primitive class.
Duplicate attribute names are resolved by policy: auto-rename, keep first, keep last, or replace only attributes from the first input.
Length mismatch handling defines both notification severity and how shorter inputs supply missing values.
common_gotchas: All attributes of the first input are sent to output; later inputs contribute only the chosen attribute class.
Length mismatch handling can hold, zero, one, or omit values for shorter inputs, so validate element counts.
Duplicate attribute policy affects whether first, last, or auto-incremented names survive.
